provenance.method: pixel-art 16x16 emote balloon sheet with 3-frame animation loops and dual framed/unframed representations
provenance.referenceRole: Resident emotional expression, congestion symptom alerts, routine indicators, and social sentiment feedback

assets.description: Crosshair target; active inspection lock or destination goal reached
assets.simulationTrigger: Inspector selection focus or transit destination arrival

assets.description: Cyan cold/shock burst; HVAC failure, power outage, or freezing room temperature
assets.simulationTrigger: Utility failure (power/HVAC) in current room

assets.description: Music notes; resident enjoying dining, cafe ambiance, or leisure time
assets.simulationTrigger: NpcActivityKind.Leisure or dining room occupancy

assets.description: Tangled scribble; lost pathfinding, blocked corridor, or broken transit node
assets.simulationTrigger: Transit routing failure or disconnected floor

assets.description: Thumbs up; high satisfaction, lease renewed, positive response to building policy
assets.simulationTrigger: Household satisfaction > 80 or successful lease signing

assets.description: Thumbs down; rent grievance, dissatisfaction, poor room conditions
assets.simulationTrigger: Household satisfaction < 30 or rent hike complaint

assets.description: Sweat droplets; commute fatigue from stair climbing or long elevator queue wait
assets.simulationTrigger: WaitTicks between 15 and 30 in elevator lobby

assets.description: Glowing lightbulb; focused work, inspiration, business productivity
assets.simulationTrigger: NpcActivityKind.Working in commercial or office room

assets.description: Downward red arrow; declining funds, worsening commute, degrading satisfaction
assets.simulationTrigger: Negative delta in satisfaction or income

assets.description: Upward cyan arrow; commute improved, promotion, positive policy impact
assets.simulationTrigger: Positive delta in commute efficiency or household income

assets.description: Sleeping Zzz; resident resting in bed during night cycle
assets.simulationTrigger: NpcActivityKind.Sleeping in residential apartment

assets.description: Shocked eye/skull; extreme crisis, hazard, catastrophic dissatisfaction
assets.simulationTrigger: Imminent vacancy abandonment or hazard zone

assets.description: Pulsing red heart; high affection, strong neighbor relationship, loved apartment
assets.simulationTrigger: Positive social interaction or top-tier room appeal

assets.description: Broken heart; tenant eviction, move-out decision, fractured friendship
assets.simulationTrigger: Tenant departure or relationship dissolution

assets.description: Pink blush lines; flustered, elevator overcrowding contact, awkward encounter
assets.simulationTrigger: Elevator car crowded to maximum capacity (>6 passengers)

assets.description: Pulsing red anger cross; severe elevator wait bottleneck or skipped car
assets.simulationTrigger: WaitTicks > 30 in transit queue

assets.description: Black exclamation mark; alert, elevator arrived, sudden route recalculation
assets.simulationTrigger: Elevator car arrival or status change

assets.description: Question mark; checking timetable, wondering when car arrives
assets.simulationTrigger: Entering transit queue (ticks 1 to 4)

assets.description: Red impact shield; dispute between neighbors or faction friction
assets.simulationTrigger: Faction tension threshold crossed

assets.description: Steaming red waves; odor complaint, uncollected trash, unbearable heat
assets.simulationTrigger: Waste utility overflow or heat hazard

assets.description: Startled interrobang; emergency alarm, unexpected eviction, sudden tax increase
assets.simulationTrigger: Emergency alert or abrupt policy enforcement

assets.description: Three walking dots; patiently waiting in queue, thinking
assets.simulationTrigger: WaitTicks between 5 and 14 in elevator queue

assets.description: Golden sun; morning wake-up routine, morning commute start
assets.simulationTrigger: Morning shift start (tick schedule transition)

assets.description: Crescent moon with stars; evening commute return, bedtime winding down
assets.simulationTrigger: Evening shift end / night schedule transition

assets.description: Empty speech bubble frames and descending thought bubble connection dots
assets.simulationTrigger: Custom text balloons or pop-in animation scaling

integrationConstraints: proposedKey is an authored candidate key; the content tool owns immutable ContentIds.
Point filtering (no anti-aliasing) required to preserve crisp pixel-art styling alongside orthographic cutaway.
Default anchor is bottom-center (0.5, 0.0) aligned with the tail of each bubble frame.
Must be anchored to Spine Head bone or overhead anchor in NpcSkeletalHierarchy.
